# Multi Lingo AI

> The first AI-powered platform that teaches you any language from any dialect you speak. AI-powered, human-supported.

Multi Lingo AI is a language-learning web app focused on real, conversational language - not textbook phrases. It combines an AI tutor available 24/7 with optional live sessions from verified human tutors.

## What it does

- **Translator** - instant, context-aware translation between any two supported languages/dialects.
- **Dictionary** - word lookups with definitions, examples, synonyms, and conjugations.
- **Challenges** - mini-games (Hangman, Word Search, Scrambled Word, Word Link, Word Ladder) that reinforce vocabulary.
- **Exam Training** - listening, reading, writing, and full-exam practice for official language certification.
- **Live tutors** - scheduled sessions with verified native-speaker tutors, via the built-in Smart Scheduler.

## Languages

European and Brazilian Portuguese, US and UK English, Spanish (Spain & Mexico), French, and German - learners can start from any of these as their base language.

## Pricing

Free tier available (Explorer). Paid tiers unlock unlimited AI conversations and live tutor sessions. See https://multi-lingo.online/pricing for current plans.
